content: Hello! how can I help today?
We had R&D expenses this year. Can we still deduct them immediately?
Not anymore. Under the **TCJA**, effective 2022, **IRC §174** requires R&D expenses to be **capitalized and amortized** over **5 years domestically** or **15 years if foreign**.
Report R&D costs on **Form 4562**, Part VI. Begin amortization in the **midpoint of the tax year incurred**. Maintain a schedule of unamortized costs.
Can I opt out of this change?
No. This is **mandatory treatment** under current law. The deduction delay is required and applies regardless of entity type.
What if we already deducted it on the books?
You’ll need to make a **§481(a) adjustment** to conform tax and book treatment. File a **Form 3115** for accounting method change, using designated DCN 265.
